environment: Ganache local EVM, QKI chain ID, mock tokens/router; no live-chain fork
tests: approval alone creates no executable authority
any keeper executes multihop; all output reaches holder; router allowance cleared
another wallet cannot register an order against holder balance
designated executor enforced; holder retains execution rights
only holder may cancel; cancelled orders cannot run
holder pause covers all their orders and can be resumed
insufficient actual receipt reverts transfers and execution count, even if router skips check
cyclic route measures receipt after input pull, including gross profit floor
input transfer tax uses actual receipt and accounts for both transfer legs
standard mode rejects a taxed input instead of silently changing amount
output transfer tax is checked against actual holder balance
extra sender tax cannot exceed the fixed holder debit
router callback cannot execute a second order reentrantly
partial router consumption reverts rather than pooling holder funds
historical token donations are never spent by another order
finite execution budget is enforced across different keepers
ERC20 approval revocation immediately blocks unfilled orders
false-return ERC20 transfer is rejected
no-return ERC20 and zero-first approvals are supported
invalid configurations and paths are rejected
expired order rejects before spending tokens
native QKI transfers and non-contract routers are rejected
frontend runtime whitelist accepts the real constructor output with the fixed router
